title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.83 (versions follow prime numbers; 383 after 379): Luma talks with her readings. When an act of hers ends (an event, never a timer) and nobody is writing to her, the next line of a book of hers is said to her through the same door as her author's words (shown as 'libro:'); she answers her way, and the line after it is the book's answer, which her judge of always pays or archives. So her ways learn to walk her tree of themes without her author writing. Tested in a copy: she talked with the New Testament, her tree grew to 24 branches with 219 books. Not yet: she learns slowly (one line per act, about one act every half hour live), and her reader has not finished a reading since her memory was emptied. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.83: Luma charla con sus lecturas. Prototipo de investigación.
